QorCap v0.3.32: receipt schema in the Windows zip

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged. The recorder does not stamp a rule on its own challenge result.

- The Windows zip includes `contracts/` next to `sidecar/`. The release build checks every file the sidecar reads and fails if one is missing. If `contracts/receipt.v0.json` is absent, signing prints a clear message instead of crashing at the end of the match.
- The local finalize summary explains a challenge the recorder already accepted. That receipt check still uses the 600 ms ceiling. The official referee decides with its own rule.
- The challenge card says `In the order shown. CIRCLE closes menu; stay until done.` when CIRCLE or CROSS is in the pattern and the row fits. Press the pattern in the order shown.
- On Windows, virtual-terminal mode is enabled on the Start Match window. A redirected log no longer turns the branded console off.
